user.title: Connect to ICT Protege
user.description: Enter the Automation and Control service details.

abort.no_devices: No devices of this type have been configured yet.

manage_entities.title: Manage Protege Entities
manage_entities.description: Search the controller to discover and add records, review or remove configured records, manually add a database ID, or rename an existing entity.

manage_search.title: Search / Refresh Controller
manage_search.description: On Protege WX, configured WX web-operator credentials are used to retrieve the authoritative database record lists and programmed names. If WX credentials are not configured or the lookup fails, Automation Service probing is used as a fallback. The scan runs once and the results remain available while this configuration session is open.

data.limit_doors: Highest Door ID to Scan (Automation fallback only)
data.limit_areas: Highest Area ID to Scan (Automation fallback only)
data.limit_inputs: Highest Input ID to Scan (Automation fallback only)
data.limit_outputs: Highest Output ID to Scan (Automation fallback only)

scan_results.title: Controller Scan Results

scan_select.title: Add {record_type}s
scan_select.description: {count} unconfigured {record_type} records are available from the cached scan. Open Records to add to see the full list; type in the picker's search box to filter it live (for example PIR), then select as many records as required. Submit returns to Controller Scan Results so you can add another type. Select all adds every available record of this type and is not limited by the picker search text. Source: {source}.

data.select_all: Select all available records (ignores search text)
data.select_none: Select none / back to scan results

manage_select.title: Select / Remove Protege Entities
manage_select.description: Existing records are preselected. This maintenance screen is mainly for reviewing or removing configured records. If a controller scan has been run in this session, its discovered records are also available here. Source: {source}.

manual_add.title: Manually Add Protege Entity
manual_add.description: Use this when controller discovery does not expose the required record. The database ID is the stable identity. The custom name is optional and can be changed later.

confirm_entity_changes.title: Confirm Entity Removal
confirm_entity_changes.description:
The following Protege records will be removed from Home Assistant only; nothing is deleted from the Protege controller:

{changes}

edit_device.title: Rename Entity
edit_device.description: Choose the Protege record type to rename.

edit_confirm.title: Rename Entity
edit_confirm.description: Set an optional Home Assistant name for record ID {id}. Leave blank to use the Protege programmed name: {programmed_name}.

configure_arming.title: Arming Panel Options
configure_arming.description: Select which arming modes should be visible on the Alarm Panel card.

configure_connection.title: Automation Service Connection
configure_connection.description: Edit the TCP Automation and Control connection. Leave Service PIN blank to keep the existing PIN.

data.password: New Service PIN (leave blank to keep current)

configure_wx_names.title: Protege WX Name Lookup
configure_wx_names.description: Enter a Protege WX web-operator username and password to retrieve the controller's programmed record names and complete WX database lists. These credentials are used only for read-only metadata lookup; monitoring and control continue to use the Automation Service. Leave the password blank to keep the saved password. To remove saved credentials, tick Remove saved WX operator credentials and Submit.

raw_editor.title: Edit Config YAML
raw_editor.description: Advanced editor for the selected Protege record dictionaries.

error.id_exists: A record of this type with that database ID is already configured.
error.wx_auth: Protege WX operator login failed. The credentials were not saved.
error.invalid_selection: The submitted selection contained an invalid or unavailable record ID.
error.no_selection: Select at least one record, or choose Select all or Select none.
error.selection_conflict: Select all and Select none cannot both be enabled.

abort.no_devices: No devices of this type have been configured yet.
